_provenance.note: Node-tree dump mapped from the Figma REST API (extract/figma/rest/map.ts, dump v1.44) for design→contract proposal.
captureGaps: variable names and multi-mode values (dump v1.4/v1.6): NOT captured because the token lacks the file_variables:read scope (Figma 403 on /v1/files/:key/variables/local — a token scope, not a plan limit): every bound fact on this dump degrades to its resolved literal (the collection’s DEFAULT mode — Light/Default — with no mode recorded), no variable NAME survives into the proposal, and the other modes’ values are absent; FIX: regenerate the token with file_variables:read and re-run
image fills (dump v1.7 imageFill / v1.9 imageHash): not captured on this route — an IMAGE paint (e.g. an avatar photo) is read as no fill and renders as an empty box
layout wrap + row spacing (dump v1.12 layout.wrap/rowSpacing): not captured on this route — a wrapping row is read as a single non-wrapping line

variables.message: Figma refused /variables/local: your personal access token does not carry the `file_variables:read` scope (HTTP 403). The import continues with resolved values; variable names stay unresolved. If figma.com → Settings → Security → Personal access tokens offers "Variables: read", mint a token with it and re-run. Figma may offer that scope only on some plans; this project has not verified which.

Input.description: A native input element. 1:1 with base-ui.com input hero: 10rem × 2rem, padding 0 0.5rem, 1px ink border, sharp corners, placeholder neutral-500 (dark: neutral-400). Focus: 2px ink ring, outline-offset −1px.

Field.description: Form field pattern: Label (bold) + Control + Description / Error. 1:1 with base-ui.com field hero: column gap 0.25rem, max-width 16rem, error text red-700 (dark: red-400).
